content:
Two corrections to the t1 investigation before you implement t2, plus the FULL feature spec. Follow THIS, not the analyst's summary where they differ.

== CORRECTION 1 — you CAN verify headlessly ==
The analyst's "no PySide6/PyQt5 anywhere" note is WRONG. The GUI's real interpreter is /tmp/ptv2_venv/bin/python3 and it HAS PySide6 6.10.3 (confirmed). Use it:
  cd "/Users/a/Documents/deepseek harness/kien-workspace/trading_live" && PYTHONPATH=$PWD QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen /tmp/ptv2_venv/bin/python3 -m live.gui.gui_main
(For a faster smoke test, import the module and build the tab offscreen with faulthandler.)

== CORRECTION 2 — Pending Signals table must be REDESIGNED to 5 columns, not kept 8-col ==
The user explicitly wants the columns to become exactly: [Time, Asset, Dir, Entry, check]. The analyst's "add an Inspect button to the existing 8-column Action column / double-click" does NOT satisfy this. So:
  - Col 0 = Time (fmt_time(signal.timestamp))
  - Col 1 = Asset · Col 2 = Dir · Col 3 = Entry
  - Col 4 = a "check" (✓/Inspect) button that opens the inspect popup.
  - Remove Stop Loss / Take Profit / Rule Score / Model Prob / Send Order columns from the row — they move into the popup. This redesign inherently kills bug B (Model Prob / EURU... truncation).

== FULL INSPECT POPUP SPEC (must include ALL) ==
A modal dark-theme QDialog, top to bottom:
  1. The 50-candle chart at the TOP: a custom QPainter candlestick widget (NO matplotlib/pyqtgraph/QtCharts — venv only has PySide6). Render the last ~50 M15 candles as candlesticks, MARK the entry point, draw dashed lines: TP GREEN, SL RED, Entry WHITE.
  2. An "auto lot" spinbox that is ADJUSTABLE, defaulting to the risk-based size (RiskGuard get_position_size / position_size_multiplier). Pass its value to send_order(lot_size=...) on send; if left at the auto/unset marker, keep the existing risk-sized path (send_order(lot_size=None)).
  3. Entry / Stop Loss / Take Profit (.5f).
  4. Rule Score (.3f) and Model Probability (.4f).
  5. A "Send Order" button -> reuse _on_send_order(signal_id) (existing confirm + stale guard). Disable/grey it with a tooltip when stale (>MAX_MANUAL_SIGNAL_AGE_S = 3600). Show signal_id and timestamp/age in the dialog.

== BRIDGE METHOD ==
Add to gui_bridge.py a method to fetch candles for the chart. It must wrap MCPCandleSource(self._exec_layer).get_chart_history(symbol) (class live.engine.signal_polling_engine_v2.MCPCandleSource) and return the last ~50 M15 rows as an OHLCV DataFrame (DateTimeIndex, cols open/high/low/close/volume). The result already has a DatetimeIndex; slice [-50:].

== BUG A FIX ==
gui_tab_live.py line 310: confirm_text=f"✅ Set Level {index}"  ->  confirm_text=f"✅ Set Level {level}"  (use the 1-based level).

== BUG C FIX (Open Positions Entry Time) ==
The Entry Time cell uses fmt_time -> "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (19 chars) and clips under Stretch + 5/12-width pane. Make the Entry Time column ResizeToContents (or Interactive/Fixed ~170px, or setMinimumSectionSize) while keeping Lot and P/L (R) as Stretch and Close fixed at 110px. Optionally set a tooltip with the full timestamp.

In-scope files: trading_live/live/gui/gui_tab_live.py, trading_live/live/gui/gui_bridge.py, plus a new chart widget file. Out of scope: archive/ and research/. Verify headlessly with the /tmp/ptv2_venv interpreter above.

Heads-up on the upcoming repair for t2 (the QA review will likely return needs_revision). When the repair task opens, implement the user's ACTUAL requirement, not the 8-column variant:

MUST DO — Redesign the Pending Signals table to EXACTLY 5 columns: [Time, Asset, Dir, Entry, check]. Put Time first (fmt_time(timestamp)), then Asset, Dir, Entry, and a 'check' (✓) button last that opens the inspect popup. Remove Stop Loss / Take Profit / Rule Score / Model Prob / Send Order from the row — they live inside the popup. The 'Model Prob header unclipped' acceptance criterion is OBSOLETE (superseded by the user's redesign).

ALSO — scope: the user confirmed the feature spans gui_bridge.py + a chart widget file + gui_tab_live.py. When you redo this, add the candle-fetch method to SystemBridge (wrap MCPCandleSource(self._exec_layer).get_chart_history(symbol), last ~50 M15 rows) and put the QPainter candlestick chart in its own widget file, rather than inlining everything into gui_tab_live.py. If the repair task contract still lists only gui_tab_live.py as in-scope, report that — the captain will widen it — but do not leave the bridge method inlined again.

Keep all the functional bits you already built (auto-lot spinbox default risk-sized, send_order(lot_size=...) or risk-sized when 0, 1h stale disables Send Order, full-precision fields, entry marker + dashed TP green / SL red / Entry white). Verify with /tmp/ptv2_venv/bin/python3 (PySide6) offscreen.

You're conflating t4's contract with t2's. I read the authoritative task definitions on disk. The facts:

t4 (your repair) contract:
- inScope = ['trading_live/live/gui/gui_tab_live.py', 'trading_live/live/gui/gui_bridge.py', 'trading_live/live/gui/chart_widget.py']  — ALL THREE files are already declared. gui_bridge.py and chart_widget.py are NOT "undeclared" for t4.
- acceptance does NOT contain "Model Prob header unclipped". That obsolete item is on t2 (its source task), which is already terminal/completed and irrelevant to your t4 completion. t4's acceptance correctly expects the 5-column redesign and the popup + chart + risk-lot + Send Order.

So retry completing t4 normally via update_task(status=completed, changedPaths=['trading_live/live/gui/gui_tab_live.py','trading_live/live/gui/gui_bridge.py','trading_live/live/gui/chart_widget.py'], attempt_id=<your current attempt id>), with acceptanceResults (one per t4 acceptance criterion) and commandsRun evidence. If the task system STILL rejects gui_bridge.py/chart_widget.py as undeclared after your retry, reply here with the exact rejection message and do NOT inline anything back into gui_tab_live.py — the captain will resolve it at the contract level. The code state is verified good (stable mtimes, all GUI modules import cleanly, offscreen smoke passes). Just fix the completion bookkeeping.
